question: On average, how many units (total quantity) does a single order at the Andheri West store contain?
sql: SELECT AVG(units) FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE s.name = 'Andheri West' GROUP BY o.id)

question: Which store ranked second by revenue in January 2026?
sql: SELECT s.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE strftime('%m', o.order_date) = '01' GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: Which product had the biggest increase in units sold from January to February 2026?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', o.order_date) = '02' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', o.order_date) = '01' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1
